display.purpose: Giant translucent jersey number watermark behind the player identity in PlayerCardHeader. Used only here.

headline.purpose: Player name in the card header. High weight for impact at a moderate size.

body.purpose: Standard chrome text — menu items, pills, coachmarks, chip labels.

label.purpose: Default small UI labels — tabs, tooltips, active chip text.

caption.purpose: Section labels, stat headers, menu meta text.

shadows.name: dot-rest
shadows.purpose: Player dots resting on the field — establishes physical distance from the green surface.

shadows.name: dot-selected
shadows.purpose: Halo around selected player dot. Actual color is team uiAccent at 40%; value shown is chrome accent approximation.

shadows.name: thumb
shadows.purpose: Toggle thumb — subtle lift to communicate draggable affordance.

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Keyboard focus indicator on inputs and interactive elements — accent-tinted glow.

motion.name: spring-sheet
motion.purpose: Bottom sheet and modal panel spring transition via Framer Motion.

motion.name: spring-dot
motion.purpose: Player dot selection scale spring — 1× to 1.18×.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Input focus border/glow transition, toggle track and thumb transition.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary action button — Steel Blue fill, on-accent text. Rare in this UI; used for true CTAs.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #6E8CAE; color: #15161a; font-family: 'Geist Sans', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; padding: 12px 20px; border-radius: 12px; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: opacity 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: 0.9; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(110,140,174,0.3); } .ds-btn-primary:active { opacity: 0.8; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.6; cursor: default; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Neutral alternative — translucent fill with hairline border. For cancel or secondary actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06); color: #dfe5f0; font-family: 'Geist Sans', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; padding: 12px 20px; border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.14); cursor: pointer; transition: opacity 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { opacity: 0.85; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(110,140,174,0.3); } .ds-btn-secondary:active { opacity: 0.75; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Quiet borderless button — for close actions and tertiary controls. Sits on its surface without decoration.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: #A5ACAF; font-family: 'Geist Sans', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; padding: 12px 20px; border-radius: 12px; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: opacity 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { opacity: 0.7; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(110,140,174,0.3); }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Single-style text input — translucent fill, hairline border, glow focus ring. Used everywhere.
components.css: .ds-input { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06); color: #f0f4ff; font-family: 'Geist Sans', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; padding: 12px 16px; border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.14); outline: none; width: 100%; transition: border-color 150ms ease-out, box-shadow 150ms ease-out; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #7d848c; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #6E8CAE; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(110,140,174,0.3); }

components.name: Card
components.description: Generic surface panel — settings, nested lists, content containers. Flat, no shadow.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #1a1e23; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08); border-radius: 24px; padding: 16px; }

components.name: Filter Pill (Active)
components.description: Active filter chip — accent fill, on-accent text. Selected state for filtering.
components.css: .ds-chip-active { background: #6E8CAE; color: #15161a; font-family: 'Geist Sans', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; padding: 6px 12px; border-radius: 9999px; border: none; cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Filter Pill (Inactive)
components.description: Inactive filter chip — translucent fill, secondary text. Default resting state.
components.css: .ds-chip-inactive { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.07); color: #dfe5f0; font-family: 'Geist Sans', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 400; padding: 6px 12px; border-radius: 9999px; border: none; cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap; transition: background 150ms ease-out; } .ds-chip-inactive:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.12); }

components.name: Segmented Control
components.description: Pill-tab group for switching modes. Translucent track, active segment fills with accent.
components.css: .ds-seg-track { display: flex; gap: 4px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.07); border-radius: 16px; padding: 4px; width: fit-content; } .ds-seg-item { font-family: 'Geist Sans', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; padding: 6px 10px; border-radius: 12px; border: none; background: transparent; color: #dfe5f0; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms ease-out, color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-seg-active { background: #6E8CAE; color: #15161a; } .ds-seg-item:not(.ds-seg-active):hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); }

components.name: Toggle
components.description: Switch control for boolean settings. Accent fill when on, navy when off. Thumb slides with spring ease.
components.css: .ds-toggle { width: 40px; height: 24px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #6E8CAE; position: relative; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms ease-out; } .ds-toggle[aria-checked="false"] { background: rgba(30,32,38,0.8); } .ds-toggle:focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(110,140,174,0.3); } .ds-toggle-thumb { width: 20px; height: 20px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #fff; position: absolute; top: 2px; left: 18px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.35), 0 1px 1px rgba(0,0,0,0.2); transition: transform 150ms ease-out; } .ds-toggle[aria-checked="false"] .ds-toggle-thumb { transform: translateX(-16px); }

components.name: Position Badge
components.description: Small pill identifying a player's position code. Accent fill, bold text.
components.css: .ds-badge-position { display: inline-block; background: #6E8CAE; color: #15161a; font-family: 'Geist Sans', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 9999px; }

narrative.overview:
depth's visual language is a dark broadcast control room. The chrome stays quiet and consistent — charcoal surfaces, translucent white-alpha fills, hairline borders — so team color is always the loudest thing on screen. Every surface is built from a small set of translucent layers stacked on a near-black ground; depth comes from alpha values, not from paint or drop shadows.

The system is compact and instrument-panel dense. Text is small by design (the entire UI chrome type scale spans 9–13 px), borders are white alpha at 6–14%, and controls are pill-shaped with tight radii. The goal is to vanish: the field, the roster, the team identity — those are the content. The interface is a frame that earns its darkness by never competing with what it holds.

Mobile-first is the structural reality. The full layout is a single column with bottom-sheet navigation; only at the xl breakpoint (1280 px) does the page expand into a viewport-height three-column grid.
keyCharacteristics: Two-tier color system: team brand colors for identity surfaces, curated legible accents for interactive content
Translucent white-alpha surfaces and hairline borders instead of solid fills and drop shadows
Compact micro type scale (9–13 px) with generous touch targets (44 pt minimum)
Pill-shaped controls with fill-based state changes, never bouncy or decorative
Dark-first with WCAG-AA-tested contrast on every curated color pair
The field itself is the visual anchor: a green gradient with white-alpha yard lines and a blue scrimmage line

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Team brand colors speak on identity surfaces; curated legible accents speak on everything that must be read on dark. Never swap their jobs.

rules.name: The Translucency Rule
rules.body: Depth on flat chrome comes from white-alpha fills layered on the charcoal ground (3% to 14% to navy 80%), not from solid color steps or drop shadows.

rules.name: The Five-Step Rule
rules.body: Every chrome label at or below 13 px takes one of the five scale steps (micro / caption / label / body / title). Same-purpose text always uses the same token.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: Borders are always white alpha at 1 px. Emphasis is encoded in opacity (6% to 14%), never in width or color.

rules.name: Shadow Means Floating
rules.body: A shadow is never decoration. It appears only on elements that are physically above another surface. Chrome surfaces at rest are always flat.

dos: Do use the Five-Step Type Scale for all chrome labels (micro 9 / caption 10 / label 11 / body 12 / title 13 px). Same-purpose text, same step.
Do route team-color-dependent text and interactive elements through curated uiAccent/onAccent, never raw brand hexes (Two-Voice Rule).
Do compose every UI surface from components/ui/ primitives. Extend with a prop before forking a new component.
Do use fill-based state changes for active/selected states — accent fill + on-accent text.
Do use white-alpha borders at 1 px to differentiate surfaces. Emphasis via opacity (6% to 14%), never width (Hairline Rule).
Do use the shared Intent vocabulary (primary / secondary / ghost / danger) across all component variant props.
Do use the z-index scale (dot 10, dotSelected 20, popover 30, backdrop 40, panel 50). Never hardcode a z-index value.
Do use skeletons sized to eventual content while data loads; never let a component render its post-load shape from data that hasn't arrived.
donts: Don't use generic 3-column white-card grids, centered-everything layouts, decorative blobs, or icon-in-colored-circle rows.
Don't style text, dots, or interactive elements with primary (raw team brand color) when uiAccent is the curated legible alternative.
Don't hand-edit team colors in the database or seed files — they are machine-owned by the weekly ESPN ingest.
Don't invent z-index values at the call site. Add a new tier to the scale instead.
Don't use arbitrary font sizes outside the five-step type scale for chrome text.
Don't add drop shadows to chrome surfaces. Shadows appear only on physically floating elements.
Don't hand-roll a styled button or div group when a components/ui/ primitive covers the use case.
Don't commit without running npm run format. Prettier is the only style authority.
Don't delete curated archive rows. Retirement is a flag, never a delete.
Don't enable RLS on a new table without shipping a read policy in the same migration.
